messages:
maya: Quick sync — I'm prototyping a new regional GPU health dashboard that scores cards with a decay-based heuristic rather than raw counters. Goal: fewer noisy ejections, faster detection of real degradation. Thoughts?

liam: Love the idea. Can you sketch the score formula?

maya: High level: score = base + w_xid * normalized_xid_rate + w_ecc * ecc_rate + w_temp * thermal_spike_index - decay * uptime_fraction
 - decay is time-decay so transient spikes fade rather than trigger immediate drain.

olga: For normalized_xid_rate, please use per-card runtime hours not wall clock. Otherwise new cards get punished on first boot.

maya: Yup — exactly. We'll normalize to errors / gpu_runtime_hours * 1e3 (errors per 1000 GPU-hours).

sri: Important callout: we need to ensure alerts still catch bursty ECC bus errors (even if short-lived) because NVLINK/ECC bursts often precede failures. Maybe a separate "burst detector" that bypasses decay.

maya: Good call. Plan: two signals — slow score (decayed) for ejection policy, and a fast burst detector that triggers paging but not auto-eject.

liam: For Grafana panels, can we add these: regional aggregated distribution (violin/box), per-rack swimlane (time vs rack), heatmap of nvlink_retry_ratio, and a small cost-impact panel (estimated replacement + lost throughput)? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

maya: Yep. I'm prototyping PromQL for the main panel — here's a draft:
```
# errors per 1000 GPU-hours per card (Prometheus labels: card_id, region, rack)
sum by(card_id) (increase(gpu_xid_total[7d])) / (sum by(card_id) (increase(gpu_runtime_seconds[7d])) / 3600) * 1000
```

olga: That looks good. For the heatmap we'll use rate(gpu_ecc_bus_errors[5m]) with a rolling 3h max to capture bursts.

sri: Suggest also adding a panel that shows the rolling median of per-card scores in a region (7d) and the 99th percentile. Helps set SLO thresholds.

maya: On SLOs: proposed SLO = "regional card-availability" target 99.95% weekly (card considered unavailable when in forced-drain or when score > eject_threshold). This accounts for maintenance drains. Thoughts on threshold?

liam: 99.95% is aggressive for some regions. Maybe set initial alert at 99.9% with a P0 pager at 99.7% until we have historical baseline.

olga: Also need to account for false positives: automated ejection cost is not trivial — replacement + reschedule cost. We should add a "drain cost estimator" into the dashboard showing historical ejection rate * avg replacement cost.

maya: Agreed. Draft cost query: `increase(card_auto_ejections_total[30d]) * ${REPLACEMENT_COST}`. I'll expose REPLACEMENT_COST as a variable.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: New Grafana folder created: /GPUMonitoring/decay-scoreboard (provisioned panels: score-trend, burst-detector, heatmap, ejection-cost).

oncall: Quick note — when you change eviction thresholds, coordinate with capacity team. We have reserved Dedicated pools with low spare capacity in eu-west-1 this week. Avoid aggressive auto-ejects there.

maya: Good reminder. I'll set region-specific eject_thresholds and an emergency global fallback that prefers turning on burst-capacity rather than mass ejections.

liam: One more technical ask: include a panel that correlates XID spikes with ipmitool sensor temps and datacenter power events (we have tags for pdu_brownout). Correlation often reveals infra-root causes.

maya: Will add a correlation matrix and link to the incident timeline.

olga: For oncall paging rules: Page for fast-burst detectors (if sustained > 30s and rate > 50x baseline) and for region 95th-percentile score breaches that exceed the alert window. Otherwise just channel-notify.

maya: Thanks — I'll iterate on the dashboard this afternoon and post screenshots. If you have small requests (panel layout, queries) drop them here and I'll incorporate. :thumbsup:

sri: Thumbs up. If you want I can run a dry-run of the decay config in the simulator to estimate FP/TP rates.

maya: Please do. Would love to see FP/TP tradeoffs before we flip auto-eject on in eu-west-1.

infra-bot: alertbot: Note: historical 30d auto-eject avg in eu-west-1 = 3.2/week, baseline replacement cost estimate = $1,200/card.

maya: Perfect — that'll help set sensible thresholds. I'll ping when screenshots are up.

liam: thanks!
